## Summary
- preserve TreeReplaced reset diagnostics in the new Behavior Tree generation without carrying stale source-node transitions
- drive the Editor Behavior Tree palette from the shared authoring schema catalog, including typed stateful decorators, valid defaults, semantic categories, and search
- expose runtime runner/entity identity in the read-only Play-mode debugger details
- add regression coverage for independent runners, stateful reset/re-entry, bounded snapshots, generation replacement, shared palette parity, and stale debugger cleanup

## Architecture
Editor, CLI, and MCP continue to use the GUI-free BehaviorTreeAuthoringService. Stable GraphId/NodeId serialization and compiled DTO contracts are unchanged; runtime/debug state remains transient.

## Validation
Use the repository-selected Windows validation mode/scope and run Editor Visual Validation because Editor Behavior Tree UI/presentation changed.
